The Identity module's hexagonal architecture combines shared entity ownership (Auth+Identity on users table), soft deletion with deletedAt on all entities, cascade soft-delete for organizations, and a full set of domain entities, application ports, use cases, and Drizzle repository adapters.

Shared error handling infrastructure: custom error class hierarchy (BaseError with 8 subclasses), Fastify onError hook, in-memory Map-based rate limit store with sliding window, per-route rate limits, and standardized API error contract.

Auth token refresh and logout flow: RefreshTokenService validates JWT, checks Redis session, rotates token pair (bcrypt hash comparison); LogoutService deletes session; Redis provides TTL-based session storage with 7-day expiry; jose for JWT signing, bcrypt for hash comparison.

nodes.label: RedisSessionStore Adapter
nodes.description: Redis-backed session store implementing session CRUD with 7-day TTL: create(jti, data, ttl), findByJti(jti), revoke(jti), deleteByUserId(userId).

nodes.label: RefreshTokenService
nodes.description: Service that validates JWT refresh token signature and type claim, looks up session in Redis, compares bcrypt hash, handles revoked/missing sessions, rotates token pair, and stores new session with 7-day TTL.

nodes.label: LogoutService
nodes.description: Service that extracts sub (user ID) from validated access token, finds and deletes session for user, returns success (idempotent).

nodes.label: POST /api/v1/auth/refresh Route
nodes.description: Fastify route for refresh token rotation. Accepts Zod-validated refreshToken, calls RefreshTokenService, returns 200 with new token pair. Error mapping: 400 (invalid_token), 401 (token_expired, token_revoked), 422 (validation_failed).

nodes.label: POST /api/v1/auth/logout Route
nodes.description: Fastify route for logout. Requires Bearer JWT access token via auth middleware, calls LogoutService, returns 200 with { success: true }. Error mapping: 401 (unauthorized).

Each has statusCode, code, and toJSON() serialization.

nodes.label: Shared Rate Limiting Module
nodes.description: Rate limiting module with Fastify plugin, InMemoryStore (Map-based sliding window), per-route overrides. Configured limits: Login 5/min, Register 3/min, Refresh 10/min per IP.

nodes.label: Hexagonal Architecture (Ports and Adapters)
nodes.description: Architectural pattern where core business logic sits in center, ports define interfaces, and adapters implement them. Enables infrastructure flexibility and testability.

nodes.label: Shared Entity Ownership (Field-Level)
nodes.description: Pattern where multiple modules share a database table with field-level ownership validation: Auth owns email/passwordHash/createdAt (immutable), Identity manages name/avatarUrl/updatedAt/deletedAt.

nodes.label: Soft Deletion Strategy
nodes.description: Deletion strategy using deletedAt timestamp on all entities. Queries filter by deletedAt IS NULL by default. Supports audit trail, recovery by clearing timestamp, and cascading soft-deletion.

nodes.label: JWT Refresh Token Rotation
nodes.description: Security pattern where refresh tokens are single-use: on each refresh, the current session is marked revoked and a new token pair is generated with a new jti. Invalidates stolen tokens.

nodes.label: Cascade Soft-Deletion
nodes.description: When an organization is soft-deleted, all teams and members are also soft-deleted (deletedAt set), preserving referential integrity without hard deletes.

nodes.label: In-Memory Rate Limit Store (MVP)
nodes.description: Map-based rate limit store using sliding window algorithm with TTL-based reset. No external dependencies. Limitation: state lost on restart, not distributed. Planned upgrade to Redis.

nodes.label: ADR: Soft-Delete Cascade Strategy

nodes.label: BaseError

nodes.label: NotFoundError
nodes.description: Domain error for missing entities. HTTP 404, error code NOT_FOUND.

nodes.label: ValidationError
nodes.description: Domain error for invalid input. HTTP 400, error code VALIDATION_ERROR. Includes details array with field-level error messages.

nodes.label: ConflictError
nodes.description: Domain error for duplicate resources. HTTP 409, error code CONFLICT.

nodes.label: UnauthorizedError
nodes.description: Domain error for missing authentication. HTTP 401, error code UNAUTHORIZED.

nodes.label: ForbiddenError
nodes.description: Domain error for insufficient permissions. HTTP 403, error code FORBIDDEN.

nodes.label: BusinessRuleError
nodes.description: Domain error for business rule violations. HTTP 422, error code BUSINESS_RULE_ERROR.

nodes.label: RateLimitError
nodes.description: Domain error for rate limit exceeded. HTTP 429, error code RATE_LIMITED.

nodes.label: InternalError
nodes.description: Domain error for unexpected failures. HTTP 500, error code SERVER_ERROR. Sanitized message (no stack traces).

nodes.norm_label: workflow module custom workflows & validation change

nodes.label: ADR-0001: Use Enum for Project Status Instead of Workflow Join Table
nodes.description: Decided to use pgEnum column on projects table for project status lifecycle (Planned, In Progress, Completed, Canceled) instead of reusing the existing workflow_states/workflow_transitions join table system. Project lifecycle is fixed and simpler than issue workflow.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0001: use enum for project status instead of workflow join table

nodes.label: ADR-0002: Compute Project Progress on Read Instead of Storing
nodes.description: Decided to compute project progress as (completedIssues / totalIssues) * 100 on every read via COUNT queries rather than maintaining denormalized counters. Accuracy is critical and progress reads are infrequent.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0002: compute project progress on read instead of storing

nodes.label: ADR-0003: Canceled as Terminal Status Instead of Hard Delete
nodes.description: Decided to use 'canceled' as terminal status instead of hard or soft delete. Satisfies spec requirement 'No hard delete', preserves audit trail, and makes project disposition explicit. On cancel, all associated issues get projectId=null.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0003: canceled as terminal status instead of hard delete

nodes.label: ADR-0001: Embed Default Workflow in Code Rather Than Database
nodes.description: Decided to embed default workflow (Todo -> In Progress -> In Review -> Done + Any -> Canceled) as TypeScript constant in src/modules/workflow/domain/default-workflow.ts rather than seeding database. Zero-touch onboarding, instant resolution for teams without custom workflow.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0001: embed default workflow in code rather than database

nodes.label: ADR-0002: Append-Only State History for Audit Trail
nodes.description: Decided to implement append-only state_history table with no UPDATE/DELETE API. Immutability enforced at both API and DB level. History entries are domain facts that must never be altered or deleted.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0002: append-only state history for audit trail

nodes.label: ADR-0003: Cancel State Transitions Bypass All Validation
nodes.description: Decided that cancel transitions always bypass validation. If target state has type 'canceled', validation returns valid=true immediately. Cancellation must always be possible regardless of workflow configuration.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0003: cancel state transitions bypass all validation

nodes.label: Project
nodes.description: Core entity representing a project that groups related issues. Has id, teamId, name, description, status (project_status enum), startDate, targetDate, createdAt, updatedAt. Belongs to exactly one team. Issues can be associated with at most one project.

nodes.label: project_status Enum
nodes.description: PostgreSQL enum type with values: planned, in_progress, completed, canceled. Used on projects table status column. Lifecycle: planned -> in_progress -> completed | canceled.

nodes.label: WorkflowState
nodes.description: Team-scoped workflow state entity. Fields: id, teamId, name (varchar 100, unique per team), type (workflow_state_type enum: unstarted, in_progress, completed, canceled), position (sort order), createdAt, updatedAt.

nodes.label: WorkflowTransition
nodes.description: Transition rule between workflow states. Fields: id, fromStateId (FK to workflow_states), toStateId (FK to workflow_states), createdAt. Unique constraint on (fromStateId, toStateId).

nodes.label: StateHistory
nodes.description: Append-only audit log of issue status changes. Fields: id, issueId (FK to issues), fromStateId (FK, nullable for initial status), toStateId (FK), userId (FK to users), createdAt. Immutable once written.

nodes.label: workflow_state_type Enum
nodes.description: PostgreSQL enum type with values: unstarted, in_progress, completed, canceled. Used on workflow_states table type column.

nodes.label: Default Workflow Definition
nodes.description: Embedded TypeScript constant in src/modules/workflow/domain/default-workflow.ts defining the default workflow: Todo -> In Progress -> In Review -> Done, plus Any state -> Canceled. Used when team has no custom workflow states.

nodes.label: CreateProject Use Case
nodes.description: Creates a new project with status Planned. Validates team membership, non-empty name, date ordering (targetDate after startDate). Dependencies: ProjectRepository, TeamMemberQuery. Publishes ProjectCreated event.

nodes.label: UpdateProject Use Case
nodes.description: Partial update of project metadata (name, description, startDate, targetDate). Validates team membership, non-empty name if provided, date ordering. Only non-status fields updated. Publishes ProjectUpdated event.

nodes.label: ChangeProjectStatus Use Case
nodes.description: Transitions project through lifecycle: planned -> in_progress, in_progress -> completed | canceled. Completed cannot be reopened. Cancel requires team admin role. On cancel, sets all associated issues' projectId=null. Publishes ProjectStatusChanged event.

nodes.label: GetProjectProgress Use Case
nodes.description: Calculates project progress as (completedIssues / totalIssues) * 100. Only direct issues count (not sub-issues). Returns 0 if no issues. Computed on read via COUNT queries. Read-only, no events.

nodes.label: AddIssueToProject Use Case
nodes.description: Associates an issue with a project. Validates same-team constraint and that issue is not already associated with another project. Publishes IssueProjectAssociated event.

nodes.label: RemoveIssueFromProject Use Case
nodes.description: Disassociates an issue from a project by setting projectId=null. Issue itself is NOT deleted. Publishes IssueProjectRemoved event.

nodes.label: WorkflowStateService
nodes.description: CRUD operations for workflow states scoped to a team. Enforces: at most one canceled type state, at least one unstarted and completed state when custom workflow defined, deletion rejected if state is referenced by transitions.

nodes.label: WorkflowTransitionService
nodes.description: CRUD operations for allowed transitions between states. Enforces: duplicate transitions rejected, deleting a state cascades deletion of its associated transitions.

nodes.label: TransitionValidationService
nodes.description: Validates whether a status change is allowed based on workflow rules. Resolves workflow (custom or default), checks target state type for cancel override, looks up valid transitions. Called by Work Module's change-issue-status use case.

nodes.label: StateHistoryService
nodes.description: Append-only recording of state changes. Immutable: no update or delete operations exposed. First status change records fromStateId as null. All entries include user who performed the change.

nodes.label: WorkflowResolutionService
nodes.description: Determines whether a team uses custom workflow or default. Uses EXISTS query against workflow_states for the team. If no rows exist, falls back to embedded default. Result cached per-request for v1.

nodes.label: ProjectRepository Port
nodes.description: Repository interface for projects. Methods: findById, findMany, create, update, findByTeam (with cursor-based pagination and optional status filter). Implemented by Drizzle adapter.

nodes.label: TeamMemberQuery Port
nodes.description: Port interface for checking team membership. Method: isTeamMember(teamId, userId). Used by project use cases to authorize operations.

nodes.label: TeamAdminQuery Port
nodes.description: Port interface for checking team admin role. Method: isTeamAdmin(teamId, userId). Used by ChangeProjectStatus to authorize cancellation.

nodes.label: IssueQuery Port
nodes.description: Port interface for querying issues related to projects. Methods: getIssuesByProject, countProjectIssues, countCompletedProjectIssues. Used by progress calculation and cancel logic.

nodes.label: IssueUpdateQuery Port
nodes.description: Port interface for updating issue project associations. Method: updateIssueProjectId(issueId, projectId | null). Used by AddIssueToProject, RemoveIssueFromProject, and cancel logic.

nodes.label: StateRepository Port
nodes.description: Repository port for workflow states. Used by WorkflowStateService, TransitionValidationService, and WorkflowResolutionService.

nodes.label: TransitionRepository Port
nodes.description: Repository port for workflow transitions. Used by WorkflowTransitionService and TransitionValidationService.

nodes.label: HistoryRepository Port
nodes.description: Repository port for state history. Used by StateHistoryService. Only exposes INSERT and SELECT operations.

nodes.label: ProjectController (Fastify Routes)
nodes.description: Fastify route handler for project API endpoints. Routes: POST /api/v1/projects, GET /api/v1/projects, GET /api/v1/projects/:projectId, PATCH /api/v1/projects/:projectId, PATCH /api/v1/projects/:projectId/status, GET /api/v1/projects/:projectId/progress, POST /api/v1/projects/:projectId/issues, DELETE /api/v1/projects/:projectId/issues/:issueId.

nodes.label: DrizzleProjectRepository
nodes.description: Drizzle ORM implementation of ProjectRepository port. Implements findById, findMany, create, update, findByTeam with cursor-based pagination.

nodes.label: WorkflowController (Fastify Routes)
nodes.description: Fastify route handler for workflow API endpoints. Routes for state CRUD, transition CRUD, transition validation, and state history.

nodes.label: ProjectCreated Event
nodes.description: Domain event published when a new project is created. Payload: projectId, teamId, userId.

nodes.label: ProjectUpdated Event
nodes.description: Domain event published when project metadata is updated. Payload: projectId, teamId, userId.

nodes.label: ProjectStatusChanged Event
nodes.description: Domain event published when project status changes. Payload: projectId, oldStatus, newStatus, userId.

nodes.label: IssueProjectAssociated Event
nodes.description: Domain event published when an issue is associated with a project. Payload: issueId, projectId, userId.

nodes.label: IssueProjectRemoved Event
nodes.description: Domain event published when an issue is disassociated from a project. Payload: issueId, projectId, userId.

nodes.label: Projects API Contract
nodes.description: API contract for project endpoints. Defines 8 endpoints with request/response schemas, status codes, error conditions. Base path /api/v1/projects.

nodes.label: Workflow API Contract
nodes.description: API contract for workflow endpoints. Defines 9 endpoints for state CRUD, transition CRUD, validation, and history. Base path /api/v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/teams/{teamId}/workflow.

nodes.label: Projects Business Specification
nodes.description: BDD/Gherkin business specification for project features. Covers 5 features: Project Creation, Project Update, Project Status Lifecycle, Project Progress Calculation, Issue-Project Association.

nodes.label: Project Module Backend Design
nodes.description: Detailed backend design for project module. Covers architecture decisions, API contracts, data model, business logic, module structure, security, and testing strategy.

nodes.label: Workflow Module Backend Design
nodes.description: Detailed backend design for workflow module. Covers architecture decisions, API contracts, data model, business logic, module structure, security, and testing strategy.

nodes.label: PRJ-S1: Project Creation Default Status
nodes.description: On creation, project status SHALL be Planned.

nodes.label: PRJ-S2: Status Transition Rules
nodes.description: Status transitions SHALL follow: Planned -> In Progress -> Completed | Canceled.

nodes.label: PRJ-S3: Completed Cannot Reopen
nodes.description: Completed projects MUST NOT be reopened.

nodes.label: PRJ-S4: Admin-Only Cancel
nodes.description: Only team admins SHALL cancel a project.

nodes.label: PRJ-DEL: No Hard Delete
nodes.description: No hard delete - use canceled status only.

nodes.norm_label: adr-0002: cycle status as database enum

nodes.label: ADR-001: Use ws Library for WebSocket Server
nodes.norm_label: adr-001: use ws library for websocket server

nodes.norm_label: adr-004: track online status in redis with ttl

nodes.norm_label: refresh token httponly cookie migration proposal

metadata.description: Defines WS connection path /ws, auth timeout 5s, message types: authenticate/subscribe/unsubscribe/ping/event

rules: NOTIF-1: type must be one of 6 defined
NOTIF-2: author excluded from own action notifications
NOTIF-7: mark-all scoped to authenticated user
NOTIF-8: creation does not fail on WS delivery failure
NOTIF-9: cycle event recipients use team membership at event time

nodes.label: ADR-0001: HttpOnly Cookie for Refresh Token
nodes.norm_label: adr-0001: httponly cookie for refresh token

metadata.description: API contract for HttpOnly cookie auth migration. Defines login, token refresh, logout endpoints with Set-Cookie headers, cookie flags (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict), and error responses.

Business specification for HttpOnly cookie token storage. Covers login sets cookie, refresh reads from cookie with body fallback, logout clears cookie. Defines CookieConfig model and security rules (XSS, CSRF, token exfiltration).

Implementation tasks for refresh token cookie migration. Scaffold (install @fastify/cookie), data layer (REFRESH_COOKIE_SECURE env), API layer (strip refreshToken from responses, set/clear cookies), security (CORS credentials), testing (17 unit tests, 61/61 auth tests pass).
Tech decisions for cookie migration. Added @fastify/cookie plugin. No other new dependencies. Existing stack unchanged (Node.js 24, Fastify 5, jose JWT, @fastify/cors with credentials).
OpenSpec config for WebSocket real-time Kanban backend change. References backend-schema, created 2026-07-27.

Architecture decision: Create WorkToGatewayBridge adapter implementing EventPublisher port to bridge work module events to gateway's InProcessEventEmitter. Zero-latency, no new infrastructure, not horizontally scalable.

Architecture decision: Validate channel access by querying module ports at subscription time. Team channels via TeamQueryPort.isUserMember, issue channels via IssueQueryPort.isUserWatchingOrAssigned, user channels verify self.

Architecture decision: Enhance AuthenticateConnection to auto-subscribe users to team/issue channels after JWT verification. Queries TeamQueryPort.getUserTeamIds and IssueQueryPort.getUserIssueIds, calls autoSubscribeUserChannels.
ADR manifest for WebSocket real-time Kanban backend. Three ADRs created: 0001 In-Process Event Bridge, 0002 Channel Access Validation, 0003 Auto-Subscription on Authentication. All accepted.

Technical design for WebSocket real-time backend. Covers 3 ADs (event bridge, channel validation, auto-subscription), WebSocket message contracts (authenticate, subscribe, unsubscribe, event broadcast), in-memory data model, security (JWT, channel validation, rate limiting), and testing strategy.

Proposal for wiring WebSocket gateway to work and identity modules. Problem: gateway not connected to rest of app, Kanban board cannot receive real-time updates. Scope: auto-subscribe, channel validation, event bridge. Out of scope: frontend, Redis/Kafka, horizontal scaling.

Post-implementation review. All requirements covered, edge cases handled, no spec leakage. Performance bounds defined (auth <100ms, channel validation <50ms, broadcast <10ms). Ready for implementation via /opsx-apply.

WebSocket gateway API contract. Connection lifecycle (authenticate within 5s), subscribe/unsubscribe messages with channel formats (team/issue/user), event broadcasting (issue/comment/label/watcher events), error codes (4001-4005), close codes.

Business specification for WebSocket real-time features. Auto-subscription on auth (user/team/issue channels), channel access validation (team membership, issue watching/assignment, user self-only), event broadcasting (issue/comment/label/watcher events with deduplication).

Implementation tasks for WebSocket real-time backend. WorkToGatewayBridge, ChannelValidator, ManageSubscription enhanced, AuthenticateConnection enhanced, WebSocket message validation, event bridge integration, cross-module ports (TeamQueryPort, IssueQueryPort), rate limiting, unit/contract tests.

Tech decisions for WebSocket real-time backend. Uses existing ws library, In-process EventEmitter for event bridge, in-memory Map for subscriptions, JWT auth via ws upgrade, Zod for validation. Configuration: WS_PORT, WS_AUTH_TIMEOUT_MS, WS_MAX_CONNECTIONS.

OpenSpec project configuration. Defines schema (backend-schema), context (Linear App Clone, English, backend service), and rules for each artifact type (proposal, specs-api, specs-business, tech-stack, design-backend, adr, tasks-backend, review).

Backend schema definition (v3). Artifact pipeline: proposal → specs-api → specs-business → tech-stack → design-backend → adr → tasks-backend → review → apply. Each artifact has template, instructions, and dependency chain.
Template for ADR manifest. Includes status, review date, in-force ADRs reviewed, new durable ADRs created (file/title/status table), and decisions not recorded section.

Template for backend design document. Sections: architecture decisions, API contracts (method/path/request/response/status codes), data model (entities/migrations), business logic (responsibility/rules/dependencies), security (auth/authz/input sanitization), testing strategy.
Template for change proposal. Sections: problem statement, motivation, scope (in scope/out of scope), impact.
Template for post-implementation review. Sections: spec compliance, edge cases, leakage check, performance bounds, migration rollback, backward compatibility, checklist.

nodes.label: API Contract Template
nodes.description: Template for API contract specifications defining endpoint structure, request/response schemas, error codes, and rate limits. Includes standard HTTP error responses (400-500) and RFC 7807-style error format.

nodes.label: Business Specification Template
nodes.description: Template for business specifications using BDD-style GIVEN/WHEN/THEN scenarios with RFC 2119 keywords. Includes data model, relationships, business rules, and security sections.

nodes.label: Backend Tasks Template
nodes.description: Task checklist template for backend implementation covering scaffold, data layer, business logic, API layer, events/messaging, security, testing, and review phases.

nodes.label: Tech Selection Template
nodes.description: Template for documenting technology selection decisions including category, decision, rationale, trade-offs, generated files, interactive review log, and ADR references.

nodes.label: Technology Templates README
nodes.description: README explaining fallback behavior for technology templates — if backend-specific templates are not found, falls back to fullstack-schema templates. Provides copy instructions for customization.

nodes.label: Architecture Template
nodes.description: Template for documenting system architecture including hexagonal/clean architecture patterns, project structure, component design, state management, data flow diagrams, security configuration, and current architectural decisions.

nodes.label: Deployment Template
nodes.description: Template for deployment configuration including infrastructure components, CI/CD pipeline, backend/frontend deployment specs, monitoring stack, and backup/recovery procedures.

nodes.label: Stack Template
nodes.description: Template for documenting technology stack choices across backend (runtime, framework, database, cache, messaging, auth), frontend (runtime, framework, state, styling, testing), shared concerns, and dev/build tooling.

nodes.label: Auth API Contract
nodes.description: API contract for authentication endpoints: POST /api/v1/auth/login (email/password, sets HttpOnly refresh token cookie), POST /api/v1/auth/refresh (token rotation, cookie-first with body fallback), POST /api/v1/auth/logout (idempotent, clears cookie). Defines UserObject and ErrorDetail TypeScript interfaces. Rate limits: 5/min login, 30/min refresh.

nodes.label: Comments API Contract
nodes.description: API contract for issue comments CRUD: GET /issues/:id/comments, POST /issues/:id/comments, PATCH /issues/:id/comments/:commentId, DELETE /issues/:id/comments/:commentId. Soft-delete pattern. Comment body max 65535 chars. Only author can edit/delete.

nodes.label: Cycles API Contract
nodes.description: API contract for cycle management: CRUD plus activate/complete/delete lifecycle. Cycles belong to teams, have draft→active→completed status flow. Only draft cycles can be deleted or have dates modified. Activating a cycle auto-completes the previous active cycle. Cursor-based pagination.

nodes.label: Issues API Contract
nodes.description: API contract for issue management: CRUD plus status change and assignee management. Issues have auto-generated identifiers (ENG-123), support parent/child hierarchy, belong to teams, can be assigned to projects and cycles, support labels. Soft-delete pattern. Cursor-based pagination with priority+creation date sorting.

nodes.label: Labels API Contract
nodes.description: API contract for label management: CRUD on workspace labels, plus attach/detach labels to issues via IssueLabel junction table. Labels have name (unique), description, color. Soft-delete pattern.

nodes.label: Notifications API Contract
nodes.description: API contract for notification system: list (with read/unread filter), mark read, mark all read, get/update preferences. Notifications delivered via WebSocket (notification:new, notification:read events). Types: issue_assigned, issue_mentioned, comment_added, statusChanged, cycle_started, cycle_completed. Preferences support inApp and email channels with per-type toggles.

nodes.label: Projects API Contract
nodes.description: API contract for project management: CRUD plus status changes (planned→in_progress→completed→canceled), progress tracking, and issue association. Projects belong to teams, track issue count and completion. Only team admins can cancel projects.

nodes.label: Sessions API Contract
nodes.description: API contract for session management: list active sessions (sorted by last activity), revoke individual session, revoke all other sessions (preserves current). Sessions track IP, user agent, rememberMe flag, creation and last activity timestamps. Only non-expired sessions returned.

nodes.label: Team API Contract
nodes.description: API contract for team management: CRUD teams under organizations, manage team members (add/remove). Teams have name and key (issue prefix like ENG). Members have admin/member roles. Cannot remove last admin. Rate limit headers included in all responses.

nodes.label: Watchers API Contract
nodes.description: API contract for issue watchers: list, add (defaults to self), remove. Watcher is a junction table linking users to issues they're watching. User must be team member to watch.

nodes.label: WebSocket Protocol Contract
nodes.description: WebSocket protocol contract for real-time communication: authenticate (JWT within 5s), subscribe/unsubscribe to channels (team/issue/user), ping/pong keepalive, event delivery. Auto-subscribes to user's team, watched/assigned issue, and personal channels. Events: issue.created/updated/deleted, comment.created/updated/deleted, label.created/updated/deleted, watcher.added/removed.

nodes.label: Workflow API Contract
nodes.description: API contract for workflow state machine: manage workflow states (unstarted/in_progress/completed/canceled with position ordering), create/delete transitions between states, validate transitions for issues, get state history. States are per-team. Transitions define allowed state changes.

nodes.label: Auth Business Specification
nodes.description: Business specification for authentication: HttpOnly cookie token storage, token refresh with rotation (single-use, reuse detection triggers session invalidation), logout (idempotent, clears cookie). Session data model with refreshToken hash in Redis. 10 business rules including cookie precedence, backward compatibility, and production-only Secure flag.

nodes.label: Comments Business Specification
nodes.description: Business specification for issue comments: team members can add/edit/delete comments, only author can edit/delete own comments. Soft-delete pattern. Body max 65535 chars. Mutation events published for CRUD operations. Cascade soft-delete when issue is deleted.

nodes.label: User Entity
nodes.description: Core user entity referenced across auth, comments, team, watchers, sessions. Has id (UUID), email, name. Referenced by session, comment author, team membership, watcher, notification target.

nodes.label: Issue Entity
nodes.description: Core issue entity with id, identifier (auto-generated like ENG-123), title, description, teamId, projectId, assigneeId, priority (0-4), statusId, labelIds, cycleId, parentId, sortOrder, timestamps. Supports soft-delete, parent/child hierarchy.

nodes.label: Comment Entity
nodes.description: Issue comment entity with id, issueId, userId, body (markdown, max 65535), timestamps, deletedAt for soft-delete. Belongs to one issue, one author.

nodes.label: Label Entity
nodes.description: Workspace label entity with id, name (unique, max 100), description (max 500), color (hex), timestamps, deletedAt. Connected to issues via IssueLabel junction.

nodes.label: Session Entity
nodes.description: Authentication session entity stored in Redis. Has id (UUID), userId (FK→User), refreshToken (bcrypt hash), createdAt, expiresAt (7-day TTL), revokedAt. Supports multi-device sessions with token rotation.

nodes.label: Cycle Entity
nodes.description: Time-boxed iteration cycle belonging to a team. Has id, teamId, name, description, status (draft/active/completed), startDate, endDate, timestamps, completedAt. Only one active cycle per team.

nodes.label: Team Entity
nodes.description: Team within an organization. Has id, organizationId, name, key (issue prefix like ENG), memberCount, timestamps. Members have admin/member roles.

nodes.label: Notification Entity
nodes.description: User notification with id, type (issue_assigned/issue_mentioned/comment_added/statusChanged/cycle_started/cycle_completed), title, body, link, readAt, createdAt. Delivered via WebSocket and stored for later retrieval.

nodes.label: Business Cycles
nodes.description: Time-boxed work periods for teams with draft, active, and completed statuses

nodes.label: Cycle
nodes.description: A time-boxed work period belonging to a team with name, dates, and status lifecycle

nodes.label: Draft Cycle Status
nodes.description: Initial cycle status where dates can be modified and cycle can be deleted

nodes.label: Active Cycle Status
nodes.description: Current working cycle status; only one active cycle per team allowed

nodes.label: Completed Cycle Status
nodes.description: Final cycle status; cannot be reactivated

nodes.label: Single Active Cycle Rule
nodes.description: A team can have at most one active cycle; activating a new cycle auto-completes the previous

nodes.label: Cycle Issue Assignment Rule
nodes.description: Issues can only be assigned to active cycles, not draft cycles

nodes.label: WebSocket Gateway
nodes.description: Manages WebSocket connections, channel subscriptions, and real-time event broadcasting

nodes.label: Gateway Connection
nodes.description: WebSocket connection with id, userId, and status (connected, authenticating, disconnected)

nodes.label: Gateway Channel
nodes.description: Named channel for event broadcasting; types: team, issue, user

nodes.label: Team Channel
nodes.description: Channel format team:{teamId}; requires team membership for access

nodes.label: Issue Channel
nodes.description: Channel format issue:{issueId}; requires watcher or assignee role for access

nodes.label: User Channel
nodes.description: Channel format user:{userId}; only the user themselves can subscribe

nodes.label: Gateway Subscription
nodes.description: Tracks which connection is subscribed to which channel; per-connection not per-user

nodes.label: Gateway Event
nodes.description: Real-time event with type, channel, data, timestamp, and userId; fire-and-forget to gateway

nodes.label: WebSocket Auth Timeout
nodes.description: Connections must authenticate within 5 seconds or be terminated

nodes.label: Auto-Subscribe on Auth
nodes.description: Connections auto-subscribe to team, issue, and user channels on authentication

nodes.label: User Online Status
nodes.description: User is online when at least one connection is active; offline when all close

nodes.label: Issue Management
nodes.description: Core work items with auto-generated identifiers, status workflow, and team scoping

nodes.label: Issue
nodes.description: Work item with identifier, title, description, status, priority, assignee, and team ownership

nodes.label: Issue Identifier
nodes.description: Auto-generated from team key + sequence (e.g., ENG-123); monotonically increasing per team

nodes.label: Issue Status Workflow
nodes.description: Default: Todo → In Progress → In Review → Done; any state → Canceled

nodes.label: Issue Priority Levels
nodes.description: 0=No Priority, 1=Urgent, 2=High, 3=Medium, 4=Low

nodes.label: Issue Soft Delete
nodes.description: Issues are soft-deleted via deletedAt timestamp; excluded from default queries

nodes.label: Sub-Issues
nodes.description: Issues can have parent issues; parent must belong to same team

nodes.label: Label Management
nodes.description: Workspace-wide categorical tagging for issues with unique names

nodes.label: Label
nodes.description: Tag with unique name (1-100 chars), optional description and color

nodes.label: IssueLabel Junction
nodes.description: Many-to-many junction table connecting issues to labels

nodes.label: Notification System
nodes.description: Event-driven notifications with real-time WebSocket delivery and 90-day expiration

nodes.label: Notification
nodes.description: In-app notification with type, title, body, link, read status, and expiration

nodes.label: Notification Types
nodes.description: issue_assigned, issue_mentioned, comment_added, statusChanged, cycle_started, cycle_completed

nodes.label: Notification Preferences
nodes.description: Per-user settings for in-app/email delivery and per-type toggles

nodes.label: Notification Expiration
nodes.description: Notifications expire after 90 days and are excluded from queries

nodes.label: WebSocket Notification Delivery
nodes.description: Best-effort real-time delivery via notification:new event on user channel

nodes.label: Project Management
nodes.description: Team-scoped project containers with status lifecycle and issue association

nodes.label: Project
nodes.description: Container with name, description, status lifecycle (Planned→In Progress→Completed/Canceled), dates

nodes.label: Project Status Lifecycle
nodes.description: Planned → In Progress → Completed or Canceled; Completed cannot be reopened

nodes.label: Project Progress Calculation
nodes.description: Progress = (completedIssues / totalIssues) * 100; only direct issues count

nodes.label: Project Cancellation
nodes.description: Only admins can cancel; cancels disassociate all issues (set projectId to null)

nodes.label: Session Management
nodes.description: Multi-device session tracking with revocation and automatic eviction at 10-session limit

nodes.label: Session
nodes.description: Active login session with device info, IP, user agent, and refresh token hash

nodes.label: Session Revocation
nodes.description: Users can revoke individual sessions or all other sessions; tokens invalidated on revoke

nodes.label: Session Eviction
nodes.description: Auto-eviction of oldest session by last_activity_at when 10-session limit exceeded

nodes.label: Team Management
nodes.description: Organization-scoped teams with unique keys, membership, and admin roles

nodes.label: Team
nodes.description: Entity with unique uppercase key (e.g., ENG), name, and organization ownership

nodes.label: TeamMember
nodes.description: Membership record linking user to team with role (admin or member)

nodes.label: Team Key Format
nodes.description: Uppercase A-Z, 1-10 chars, unique within organization, used as issue prefix

nodes.label: Last Admin Protection
nodes.description: The last admin of a team cannot be removed; at least one admin must remain

nodes.label: Team Cascade Soft-Delete
nodes.description: Soft-deleting a team soft-deletes memberships and nullifies issue teamId

nodes.label: Issue Watchers
nodes.description: Users can watch issues to receive notifications; team membership required

nodes.label: IssueWatcher
nodes.description: Junction record linking user to watched issue; unique constraint on (issueId, userId)

nodes.label: Watcher Mutation Events
nodes.description: issue.watcher.added and issue.watcher.removed events published on changes

nodes.label: Custom Workflow
nodes.description: Team-scoped workflow states and transitions; falls back to embedded default if none defined

nodes.label: WorkflowState
nodes.description: Named state with type (unstarted/in_progress/completed/canceled), team-scoped

nodes.label: WorkflowTransition
nodes.description: Directed edge between two WorkflowStates defining allowed status changes

nodes.label: StateHistory

The Identity module's hexagonal architecture combines shared entity ownership (Auth+Identity on users table), soft deletion with deletedAt on all entities, cascade soft-delete for organizations, and a full set of domain entities, application ports, use cases, and Drizzle repository adapters.

Shared error handling infrastructure: custom error class hierarchy (BaseError with 8 subclasses), Fastify onError hook, in-memory Map-based rate limit store with sliding window, per-route rate limits, and standardized API error contract.

Auth token refresh and logout flow: RefreshTokenService validates JWT, checks Redis session, rotates token pair (bcrypt hash comparison); LogoutService deletes session; Redis provides TTL-based session storage with 7-day expiry; jose for JWT signing, bcrypt for hash comparison.
